skill.name: ego-browser

description.zh: 基于 ego lite 浏览器的网页自动化：在隔离的 Agent 空间里复用用户已登录的浏览器状态，完成打开网页、填表、点击、截图、抓取数据、测试 Web 应用等任务。需安装 ego lite 桌面应用（目前仅 macOS），未安装时会回落到内置浏览器工具。
description.en: Chromium-based browser automation via the ego lite app: agents work in an isolated space reusing the user's logged-in browser state for navigation, forms, clicks, screenshots, scraping, and web app testing. Requires the ego lite desktop app (macOS); falls back to built-in browser tools when absent.

skill.usageExample: 用 ego 浏览器打开我已经登录的 GitHub，把我仓库的 star 数和最近一次 release 抓下来。
